column3: “Holding in his hand” is moved to the chain.
BSB leaves out “who deceives the whole world” (πλανῶν).
BSB follows the critical text with “shut it” (the Textus Receptus has “shut him”). “Threw” renders ἔβαλεν.
“Had been given authority to judge” renders “judgment was given to them”; “and I saw” is added before “the souls.” “They came to life” renders ἔζησαν.
“Did not come back to life” renders ἔζησαν (“did not live”), which matches the Textus Receptus “lived again.”
“Those who share” renders the singular “the one having a part.”
BSB follows the critical text with no “from God.” “Across the broad expanse of the earth” renders “over the breadth of the earth.”
“Into which … had already been thrown” recasts “where also the beast and the false prophet [are].”

BSB follows the critical text with “before the throne.” “There were open books, and one of them was the Book of Life” recasts “books were opened, and another book was opened, which is [the book] of life.”
“Its dead” and “their dead” recast “the dead who were in it/them.”
BSB follows the critical text with “the lake of fire” at the end.
